meta.name: architecture-patterns
meta.description: Implement proven backend architecture patterns including Clean Architecture, Hexagonal Architecture, and Domain-Driven Design. Use this skill when designing clean architecture for a new microservice, when refactoring a monolith to use bounded contexts, when implementing hexagonal or onion architecture patterns, or when debugging dependency cycles between application layers.

copy.tagline: 用成熟模式搭建后端架构,消除层间依赖纠缠
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正为后端代码的层与依赖关系头疼
copy.tagline_en: Design clean backend architecture and eliminate tangled dependencies.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are struggling with layered architecture and dependency cycles in your backend.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按整洁架构、六边形架构和领域驱动设计等方法，把你的后端模块组织成分层结构，明确各层之间的依赖规则、接口定义和测试边界；遇到层间依赖循环等问题时也会给出修复方案。
howto.when: 当你要设计新微服务、按限界上下文拆分单体，或调试层间依赖循环时触发；也适用于实现六边形/洋葱架构等场景。

say.text: 帮我用整洁架构设计一个用户微服务，定义好分层和接口。
say.note: Claude 会给出分层结构和依赖规则。

say.text: 订单模块用了用户实体，如何引入防腐层隔离上下文？
say.note: Claude 会建议用防腐层隔离上下文。

say.text: 我的用例测试依赖数据库，怎么改成内存实现？
say.note: Claude 会指导使用内存适配器替代真实数据库。

howto.what_en: Given a backend module, Claude produces layered structure, dependency rules, interfaces, and test boundaries using Clean/Hexagonal/DDD patterns. It also helps fix dependency cycles and framework leakage.
howto.when_en: Triggered when designing new microservices, refactoring monoliths into bounded contexts, or debugging dependency cycles between layers. Also for implementing hexagonal/onion architecture patterns.

say_en.text: Design a user microservice with Clean Architecture layers and interfaces.
say_en.note: Claude will provide layered structure and dependency rules.

say_en.text: Order module uses User entity; how to add an Anti-Corruption Layer?
say_en.note: Claude will suggest isolating contexts with an ACL.

say_en.text: My use-case tests depend on a database; how to switch to in-memory?
say_en.note: Claude will guide using in-memory adapters.
